worldcombat.skill.babydolleyes.summary: Open wide round eyes at one visible foe to lower its Attack; it needs line of sight and fizzles behind cover. The wind-up is very short, so it almost always lands first; a stare drops more for longer, but is slower.
worldcombat.skill.babydolleyes.use.0: Soften a physical threat that has closed in
worldcombat.skill.babydolleyes.use.1: Get a first-strike drop in before it swings
worldcombat.skill.babydolleyes.use.2: Help an ally blunt a foe that is on top of you
worldcombat.skill.babydolleyes.descripti: The softened target carries the softened mark for %2$s, during which companions will not gaze at it again; when its Attack can really fall it loses %1$s stage(s) (a target that is immune or already bottomed out keeps the mark without dropping). That Attack loss is a stat stage: it does not wear off when the mark expires, only when the target leaves the fight and its stages are reset.
Gaze range %1$s blocks, on one visible foe only; it needs line of sight and fizzles when cover blocks it.
Windup %1$s, recovery %2$s. The windup is far shorter than an ordinary move, so it almost always lands first.
worldcombat.skill.babydolleyes.stare.on: Stare: 2 stages, further and longer, but its wind-up %1$s and cooldown %2$s blunt the first-strike edge.
worldcombat.skill.babydolleyes.stare.off: Glance: 1 stage, short range and cooldown; the shortest windup, landing before the foe.
worldcombat.skill.babydolleyes.timing: Range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s, recovery %3$s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.babydolleyes.preferenc: On, a glance becomes a stare: 2 stages, further and longer, but a longer windup and cooldown and a weaker first-strike edge; off keeps it quick and close.
The companion only opens its eyes while a threat is within this many blocks; smaller stays at point-blank, larger approaches on its own.
Counter only opens its eyes when the target is attacking it or its owner, or when it was just hurt; anytime opens on any visible threat.
When on, a Hold order does not stop the companion from leaving its post to use Baby-Doll Eyes.
